normative.import.err.parse: Error importing an official file into the Library: the file cannot be read; {detail} = technical detail.
normative.lib.import.done: Message after importing an official file into the Library; {id} = list abbreviation, {entries} = entries read, {screenable} = entries with a structure, {unresolved} = entries without.
normative.dl.err.catalog: Regulatory lists download error: the catalog is not valid; {detail} = technical detail.
normative.dl.err.http: Regulatory lists download error: HTTP response from the site; {status} = code (e.g. 404).
normative.dl.err.hash: Regulatory lists download error: a piece or the whole file does not have the expected SHA-256 fingerprint; {what} = which one.
normative.dl.progress: Progress of the download of the regulatory lists; {piece} = current piece, {pieces} = total pieces.
normative.lib.coverage: Coverage of a list in the Libraries window; {entries} = entries of the list, {screenable} = entries with a structure searched, {groups} = groups and mixtures, {inorganic} = inorganic entries.
